details: No malicious behavior was identified in this package version. There are no lifecycle scripts performing remote fetch-and-execute, no top-level network I/O on import, no credential or environment scraping, no hardcoded attacker-controlled destinations, and no embedded third-party credentials. The package appears to be a math/utility helper with no concerning install- or import-time side effects.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
